get.summary: Readiness: configuration loaded and port bound; never a shared dependency (§10.2).
List devices: your own, and those of the tenants you administer.

201.description: Registered; send its id in X-Kura-Device

401.description: Invalid token, or a session whose device was revoked

403.description: Not a member of any tenant

delete.summary: Revoke a device: yours, or one of a tenant you administer.

404.description: No such device you may revoke

400.description: Invalid name, or the name is taken

delete.summary: Delete an API-managed vault (tenant admin): disabled now, purged after 30 days.

403.description: Not a tenant admin, or declared in configuration

put.summary: Bind a role on a vault (vault manager or tenant admin, §6.2).

delete.summary: Remove an API-managed binding (vault manager or tenant admin).

put.summary: Store a file version's manifest; every chunk must already be present.

422.description: Hash mismatch, a chunk missing, or sizes that disagree

get.summary: Entries changed after a cursor, oldest first.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The last `seq` this device applied; 0 for a first sync.

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: The epoch the cursor was read under; a different one answers 410.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
The cursor this pass began from, when `since` is a later page of it:
the horizon is checked against it, since a pass from 0 crosses the
horizon page by page without having missed anything (absent: `since`).

200.description: At most 1,000 entries; follow `next` for more

410.description: cursor_expired, or history_rewound: run a full resync

post.summary: Which of these chunks the vault lacks; present ones are kept from garbage collection.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: BLAKE3 of the plaintext, lowercase hex

put.summary: Upload one chunk; its BLAKE3 must be its address.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: BLAKE3 of the plaintext, lowercase hex

post.summary: Push operations; each comes back accepted or conflicted (merged from phase 4).

200.description: One result per operation, in order

422.description: A forbidden path, a blob not uploaded, or an idempotency key reused with another body

get.summary: Every live entry, by id: what `kura attach` matches local files against.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The last entry id of the previous page.

200.description: At most 1,000 entries; follow `next` for more

post.summary:
Restores a revision: a new revision with its content, through the commit
path, so the vault lock, `seq`, notifications and the conflict rules all
apply (§6.9). A deletion is not restorable: restore the revision before it.

404.description: No such vault, entry or revision

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The last `seq` of the previous page.

200.description: At most 1,000 revisions; follow `next` for older ones

get.summary: The vault's notifications, over a WebSocket opened with a ticket.

101.description: WebSocket: JSON `change`, `pull` and `ping` notices; closed 4003 for a used, expired or unknown ticket, 4004 for another vault's, 4001 when the token behind it expires, 4002 on revocation, 4008 past 4 sockets, 4009 when too slow

429.description: Over 60 attempts a minute from this address

post.summary: A ticket for this device and vault.

Full-text and file-name search in one vault (§6.7): the query travels in
the body, never the URL (T19).

409.description: search_disabled: the tenant has no index

get.summary: The vault's tokens, newest first; never a secret.

post.summary: Issues a read-only token for this vault; the secret is in this answer only.

400.description: No address range, a /0 range, a bad prefix or expiry

delete.summary: Revokes a token at once, on every replica (the next use is refused).

generation.description: SHA-256 of the stored files, hex; absent before the first reconciliation.

objects.description: One entry per declared or removed object, `Ready` condition first.

rejection.description: This replica's last rejected change, `file#index path: message`.

epoch.description: Changes when the server loses history (§6.3); send it back with `since`.

headSeq.description: The head this page was read against, in the same snapshot.

next.description: Set when more pages follow: the next `since` (changes) or `after` (entries).

epoch.description:
The epoch this device's state was built under: another one answers
`410 history_rewound` (§6.3). Absent on a first push.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique per device for 7 days; a retry reuses it with the same body.

space.description:
`config`: the caller's own Obsidian configuration for its device's
profile (§6.8); absent: the notes.

cidrs.description: Client addresses allowed, at least one; never `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`.

prefix.description: A folder the token sees, ending with `/`; absent: the whole vault.

name.description: An RFC 1123 label, unique in the tenant.

owner.description: The owner's subject, shown only to a tenant admin for others' devices.

EntryId.description: A stable entry id, chosen by the client: a UUIDv7 (§6.3).

EntryState.description: An entry's current state, as `changes` and commit results return it.

token.description: `kura_<id>_<secret>`: shown once, never stored in clear.

hashes.description: Chunk hashes, 64 lowercase hex characters each, at most 1,000.

missing.description: The requested hashes the vault does not hold, in request order.

OpResult.description: The result of one operation, in request order.

oneOf.description: The conflict file holding the pushed content, when one was created.

head.description:
The pushed entry as it now stands. For a new entry unified with an
identical one at the same path, that other entry.

oneOf.description: Create (no `base`) or update an entry: its content, its path, or both.

base.description: The revision this edit started from; absent for a new entry.

blob.description: The blob address (`blob_hash`) of the content, already uploaded.

oneOf.description: Delete an entry, as of the revision the client last saw.

Operation.description: One operation of a commit. A rename is a `put` with another path.

type.description: Relative URI under `/v1/problems/`, stable across releases.

role.description: `viewer`, `editor` or `manager`, at most your own role.

name.description: Shown in device lists and conflict file names, 1 to 64 bytes.

RestoreRequest.description: `POST /vaults/{v}/entries/{e}/restore`: a new revision with this one's content.

RevisionInfo.description: One stored revision of an entry (`GET …/entries/{e}/revisions`, §4.4).

next.description: Set when older revisions follow: the next `before`.

snippet.description: Text around the first match; absent past the decryption budget.

query.description: Web search syntax (`"exact phrase"`, `-word`, `or`); at least 2 characters.

ticket.description: Single use, valid `expiresIn` seconds; send as `?ticket=`.

chunking.description: FastCDC parameters in bytes; clients never use a compiled-in value (§6.4).

configSync.description: The Obsidian configuration categories that sync (§6.8); empty: none.

bearer_token.description: OIDC access token from Authentik, verified per RFC8725: pinned algorithms, issuer, audience, expiry and the `scope` claim

ws_ticket.name: ticket
ws_ticket.description: From POST /vaults/{v}/events/ticket: 256 random bits, single use, 30 s
